record.reason: Hallo-Liveはdual-stream diffusionのstudentをstreaming化し、Future-Expanding Attention、autoregressive audio-video KV cache、few-step DMDを使う。実験は2x H200で20.38 FPS/0.94s、teacher比16x throughput・99.3x lower latencyを報告。ただし対象はtext-conditioned avatar diffusionでありLLM token decode/LLM serving最適化ではない。
record.title: Hallo-Live: Real-Time Streaming Joint Audio-Video Avatar Generation with Asynchronous Dual-Stream and Human-Centric Preference Distillation
